title: pre-launch hook payload (stdin)
description: Fired at launch order step 2, before anything is created (no agent record exists: object_id and status are null; AGENT_SPAWN_ID is empty). Never fired on resume. Exit 13 escalates (launch exits 13; re-run with --override-escalation, human-only, which sets override_escalation true), any other non-zero exit or a timeout vetoes (exit 11). A decision_id on the hook's JSON stdout is recorded.

object_id.description: null: no agent record exists yet (launch order step 2).

labels.description: The labels the agent will get, including job= when it will be added.

kind.description: The explicit --kind; null: claude-session's default kind.

run_kind.description: The run kind of claude-session's classification dry run.

reads_third_party.description: The classification of the run to be launched: claude-session start --dry-run's profile.reads_third_party or taints.

status.description: null: no agent record exists yet.

event_id.description: agent-spawn's event id, unique per event across agents; delivery is at least once: deduplicate on it.

worktree.description: Worktree mode: new, none or the absolute path to adopt.

name.description: --name, else --worktree-name; null when the name derives from the agent id, which is not allocated yet.

settings.description: The full launch settings agent-spawn will store.

pass_throughs.description: The claude-session flags given, by name (e.g. sandbox, permission_profile, env_allowlist_only, setting_sources), with their values; never prompt text.
